**💡 Today's learning:** "Multigrain bread is whole-grain bread"
- **🤔 What people believe:** A loaf that says multigrain, seven-grain or cracked wheat must be the healthy whole-grain kind.
- **🔬 The fact:** A Mayo Clinic dietitian says words like multigrain, seven-grain or cracked wheat don't guarantee a whole grain (Mayo Clinic, 28 Sep 2017). What you want is a label that actually says whole grain.
- **🎯 How they fool you:** The grain count goes on the front because it sounds wholesome, even when the bread isn't whole grain. Read the ingredient list or look for a whole-grain stamp instead.
- **Source:** https://newsnetwork.mayoclinic.org/discussion/mayo-clinic-minute-why-whole-grains-are-the-healthier-choice
